Definition: Paltiel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Paltiel or Phaltiel = "God delivers"; 1) son of Azzan and prince of the tribe of Issachar appointed as one of the 12 to apportion the land of Canaan; 2) son of Laish of Gallim to whom Saul gave Michal in marriage after his mad jealousy had driven David forth as an outlaw
